title: check crashes when .git is a file (git worktree)
description: Found 2026-10-23 by the faq3.12 worktree agent: in a git worktree .git is a file, so _fetched reading .git/vouch-fetched raises NotADirectoryError and git vouch check prints a traceback (tests/test_skeleton.py::test_unimplemented_command_fails_cleanly fails in a worktree). Resolve the git dir with git rev-parse --git-dir (or --git-common-dir as appropriate) instead of assuming .git is a directory, and never traceback to the user.
acceptance_criteria: check and sync work from a git worktree and a normal checkout; test runs the suite's skeleton case inside a real git worktree; no traceback.
